yasyf-home roster + config-dir audit (read-only; dump saved at ~/.cc-pool/roster-dump-20260725.txt via sqlite3 immutable=1 — plain -readonly hits the WAL SQLITE_CANTOPEN quirk):

- **20 active accounts** (acct-01..acct-20): labels Yasyf, yasyfm, Aneta ×2 (distinct uuids), rebecccafang, UCSF, rebeccafang_2005, Yasyf-1..Yasyf-13. acct-11 = "Yasyf-8"; acct-18 = "Yasyf-11" (uuid c53cdaa9… — matches the serve.log "deferred: acct-18 has N live session(s)" lines, same account confirmed).
- **17 of 20 config dirs are MISSING on disk** (~/.cc-pool/accounts/acct-NN/ — only acct-10/16/18 exist, and those are gutted, 3-4 entries each). Matches the pre-stop lstat errors. The swarm didn't just strand the store schema — most account config dirs are gone.
- **No complete backup exists**: only accounts.pre-native-hotfix-20260722-0459 has content, a partial 6-account snapshot (acct-05/10/13/14/16/18). Recreate + fresh per-account logins is confirmed as the only path, user-gated.
- Old serve confirmed still executing the 0.23.0 image post-upgrade (lsof txt) — restart mandatory when unblocked. Handshake-failure baseline 1127 @ 17:52 PDT, still incrementing (now failing on the missing cc-pool sync.sock).
- synckitd 0.36.2 offers NO consumer-manifest generation: `install` installs only its own LaunchAgents; `register <path>` installs a manifest you already have. cookiesync's manifest must come from cookiesync's own binary (cookie-sync repo) — add to the re-registration follow-ups alongside reposync and cc-pool; archive its stale manifest with the others when the cutover runs.

Home fully parked pending the reposync verdict + box empirical results (box's archive-aside → host add → restart will answer the empty-manifests startup question).
